notes.subject: to the nations
notes.rationale: imperative opening summons the nations to rejoice — the song's climax.

notes.subject: גוים עמו
notes.rationale: 'nations [rejoice] with his people' (KJV) vs 'of his people' (JPS); chose 'with', reading corporate rejoicing.

notes.subject: כפר
notes.rationale: kipper is expiate/atone, 'cover'; rendered 'klinim' (cleanse) as nearest Tanakh-register sense for land.

notes.subject: textual witnesses
notes.rationale: 4QDeut and LXX add 'Rejoice, O heavens... let all sons of God bow', reflected in BSB; MT lacks the line.

translation: Ol lain bilong olgeta kantri, sing aut strong wantaim ol man bilong en, bikos blut bilong ol wokman bilong en bai i givim bek pe, na pe bai i tanim bek long ol birua bilong en, na bai i klinim graun bilong en, ol man bilong en.
